GET /markets.query: SELECT market, count(DISTINCT ticker) tickers, count(*) bars FROM ohlc GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY tickers DESC

GET /ggg?market=IN&limit=3.query: SELECT market, ticker, D, V, M, composite, label FROM dvm_composite WHERE code='GGG' AND market='IN' ORDER BY composite DESC LIMIT 3

GET /ggg.query: SELECT market, ticker, D, V, M, composite, label FROM dvm_composite WHERE code='GGG' ORDER BY composite DESC LIMIT 25

GET /filter?predicate=roe%20%3E%2015.query: SELECT c.market, c.ticker, c.D, c.V, c.M, c.composite, c.code, f.roe, f.de, f.pe FROM dvm_composite c LEFT JOIN fundamentals f ON c.ticker=f.ticker WHERE roe > 15 ORDER BY c.composite DESC LIMIT 30
